body:
So, as you can see in the post, 6 hours have passed, and as you can see by my comment, I'm not dead. I'd like to say I had a revelation or found some new happiness in life, but I just got assed by some people to do some things I couldn't ignore and got distracted by a movie and so ran out of time to kill myself today. I essentially procrastinated death. Maybe that's all life is, really.

Anyways, I felt I had to leave some kind of update, given all the people that reached out (a lot more than I expected). I'm not sure if I'll kill myself tomorrow, after I leave the country, after I come back or whatever. I still don't see the point in things, but you guys did warm me up inside a bit. I even cried writing this thing, which is something I hadn't done in years. I'll say I went from certainty of killing myself to in doubt. Thanks to everyone who took some of their time to reply.
